worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement between $t=0$ and $t=2.$ Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{0}^{2}(-3{t}^{2}+6t)\,\text{dt} \\  & =(-{t}^{3}+3{t}^{2}){|}_{0}^{2} \\  & =[-(2)^{3}+3(2)^{2}]-[-(0)^{3}+3(0)^{2}] \\  & =[-8+12]-0 \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$
